morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Invisible on karyotype. A normal karyotype does **not** exclude 9814 — FISH or RT-PCR required before falling back to 9811.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Base B-ALL code (CD19 strong + ≥1 of CD10/cCD22/cCD79a, TdT+, MPO−; Dworzak dominant-lineage rule, Pathway §2.3). Upgrade to 9812–9819 only on a documented genetic result. A normal karyotype must not close the branch — ETV6::RUNX1 is cryptic and needs FISH or RT-PCR (§4.4). Landing code for the uncoded B-ALL entities of §5.2 (DUX4-r, ZNF384-r/-like, MEF2D-r, MYC-r, NUTM1-r, TCF3/4::HLF, CDX2/UBTF, PAX5 P80R, PAX5alt, IKZF1 N159Y, iAMP21) — record the genotype in genotype_annotation. KMT2A-r BCP-ALL can drop out of the lineage algorithm (CD10-negative, weak cCD22/cCD79a) and must not default to AML or MPAL. Also the code family for B-ALL in Down syndrome (§4.5), which is a distinct entity from TAM and ML-DS.
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with t(9;22)(q34;q11.2); BCR-ABL1
morphology_entries.coding_note: Requires karyotype t(9;22) plus FISH or RT-PCR (record p190 versus p210). Distinguish from CML in lymphoid blast phase: >5% lymphoblasts with BCR::ABL1 and a documented preceding chronic phase is 9875, not 9812 (§3.9).
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with t(v;11q23); MLL rearranged
morphology_entries.coding_note: KMT2A break-apart FISH required. Phenotype trap: KMT2A-r BCP-ALL is characteristically CD10 dim/negative and CD24 negative with weak cCD22/cCD79a — do not let it fall out of the B-lineage algorithm into AML or MPAL (§2.3).
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with t(12;21)(p13;q22); TEL-AML1 (ETV6-RUNX1)
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Invisible on karyotype. A normal karyotype does **not** exclude 9814 — FISH or RT-PCR required before falling back to 9811.
morphology_entries.coding_note: CRYPTIC — detectable by FISH or RT-PCR only, never by karyotype. A 'normal karyotype' result must route to a FISH-status prompt, never terminate to 9811 (§4.4, §7.5).
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.coding_note: Karyotype >50 chromosomes or DNA index. Trap: masked hypodiploidy — a hypodiploid clone that has doubled reads as hyperdiploid on karyotype. SNP array or DNA index unmasks it; misreading inverts prognosis (9815 versus 9816) (§3.1).
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with hypodiploidy (Hypodiploid ALL)
morphology_entries.coding_note: Near-haploid 24–31 chromosomes or low-hypodiploid 32–39 chromosomes. Check for masked hypodiploidy (a doubled clone mimics hyperdiploidy) using SNP array or DNA index. Low-hypodiploid cases warrant germline TP53 testing — about 50% carry a germline TP53 variant (Li-Fraumeni); record via germline_predisposition (§3.1).
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with t(5;14)(q31;q32); IL3-IGH
morphology_entries.coding_note: Karyotype plus FISH. Clinical clue: peripheral eosinophilia in a B-ALL should prompt testing for t(5;14) IL3::IGH before the eosinophilia is attributed to a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia (§1, §3.1).
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with t(1;19)(q23;p13.3); E2A-PBX1 (TCF3-PBX1)
morphology_entries.coding_note: Karyotype plus FISH or RT-PCR. Phenotypic prompt only (not a code substitute): CD9 strong with CD34 negative (§3.1).
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Down syndrome-associated — confirm trisomy 21 karyotype and GATA1s.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Added to the registry code set at ICD-O-3.2 (Pathway §5.7); previously and wrongly advised to 9811. Requires a documented Ph-like signature — CRLF2 rearrangement, an ABL-class fusion or a JAK-STAT lesion — by FISH or RNA-seq; BCR::ABL1 itself must be negative (that is 9812). Enriched in Down-syndrome B-ALL, which is why the trisomy 21 alert is attached (§5.5.1). NOTE: not present in the ICCC-2017 recode table (which predates ICD-O-3.2); Ia1 assignment follows Pathway §1 by analogy with 9811–9818. No REDCap dropdown option exists for this code — registry action required before this terminal can be selected in REDCap.
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia1. Nodal or extranodal presentation → Group II, IIb1. Marrow blasts ≥25% resolves to Group I regardless of the nodal mass. Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.coding_note: Stage 2B morphology-only terminal — lymphoblasts on marrow morphology/cytochemistry with lineage not resolved by flow or IHC. Record why via workup_status (pending / not done / unavailable / declined). Upgrade to 9811 or 9837 once lineage markers are available (§2.5).

RETIRED at ICD-O-3.2 — replaced by 9811/3 (Pathway §5.3.4, §5.7). Retained so aliases and pre-2021 archival records resolve; must never be selected as a live terminal and must never be the nos_fallback_code of another entry.

cCD3 or sCD3 positive plus CD7 positive with cMPO negative or weak (all three required, Dworzak). Landing code for ETP-ALL, near-ETP and BCL11B-rearranged ETP — none has an ICD-O-3 code (§3.2, §5.2); record the Chandra 5-marker score and phenotype in genotype_annotation. Boundary with T/myeloid MPAL (9809) is MPO: MPO-positive by the Bras rule (≥20% of blasts above the lymphocyte-derived threshold) is 9809, MPO-negative is 9837 (§4.2).

morphology_entries.morphology_name: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ This entity is described almost exclusively in adults. Confirm independently in a paediatric patient and flag for senior pathology review before finalising.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Requires ≥5×10⁹/L clonal B cells sustained ≥3 months plus the ERIC/ESCCA core panel (CD19, CD5, CD20, CD23, kappa, lambda); borderline cases add CD43, CD79b, CD81, CD200, CD10, ROR1 (§3.11). Adult-only entity — retained in the code set per §7.5, do not remove.
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 → Group I, Ia2 (CLL). C42.2 (spleen) and every nodal/extranodal site → Group II, IIb2 (SLL). Discriminator is the captured variable `primary_compartment`, asked router-side.

morphology_entries.coding_note: RETIRED for diagnoses from 1 January 2021 — leukaemic Burkitt codes 9687/3 and moves to Group II (IIc). Registry ruling: adopt 9687, no Group I/II override (Pathway §3.3, §5.3.11, §5.7c). Retained so aliases and pre-2021 archival records resolve; must never be selected as a live terminal and must never be the nos_fallback_code of another entry. sIgM is not the gate in either direction; MYC rearrangement is required (absence excludes Burkitt). Where FISH is unavailable, Ki-67 >95% with MYC protein IHC >80% predicts MYC-r in about 99% (§3.3). Time-series discontinuity — flag to biostatistics for trends spanning the change.
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Not topography-split (Pathway §5.5.2). ICCC-2017 assigns 9826 to Ia2 across all topography (C00.0–C80.9). The Group I versus Group II question for Burkitt is code-selection (9826 versus 9687), decided by the >25% marrow blast rule, not topography routing.

morphology_entries.coding_note: Kept live as the lineage-indeterminate fallback (Pathway §5.3.5); ICD-O-3.2 lists it Preferred/current. Prefer 9833 (B-cell type) or 9834 (T-cell type) whenever lineage is determinable — 9832 is for the genuinely indeterminate residual only. Diagnosis of exclusion: rule out CLL transformation, mantle cell lymphoma and splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ This entity is described almost exclusively in adults. Confirm independently in a paediatric patient and flag for senior pathology review before finalising.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Diagnosis of exclusion (ICC) — rule out CLL transformation, mantle cell lymphoma and splenic marginal zone lymphoma before coding (§3.11). Adult-only entity — retained per §7.5, do not remove.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ This entity is described almost exclusively in adults. Confirm independently in a paediatric patient and flag for senior pathology review before finalising.
morphology_entries.coding_note: CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123 positive with annexin-A1; BRAF V600E confirmatory. HCL-variant and splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukaemia with prominent nucleoli are BRAF V600E negative, have no dedicated code and fall to 9940 with a variant flag (§5.2) — the variant status does not change the code. Adult-only entity — retained per §7.5, do not remove.

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Mature T-cell and NK cell leukemias
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ ATLL — HTLV-1 serology mandatory; cannot diagnose without confirmed positivity. An unconfirmed mature T-cell leukaemia goes to 9820, not 9827.
morphology_entries.coding_note: HTLV-1 serology is mandatory and code-defining — an unconfirmed mature T-cell leukaemia goes to 9820, never to 9827 (§3.11, §6). Serology is recorded under Molecular/PCR in this schema's closed test vocabulary. Shimoyama subtypes (acute / lymphomatous / chronic / smouldering) are code-neutral — all remain 9827. Adult-only in practice (decades of latency).
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by compartment. Leukaemic phase (C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4) → Group I, Ia3. Lymphomatous phase, nodal or extranodal → Group II, IIb3. Shimoyama subtype is recorded as annotation and does not change the code.

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Mature T-cell and NK cell leukemias
morphology_entries.coding_note: CD3+CD8+CD57+ with a clonal TCR rearrangement; STAT3/STAT5B mutation supportive. Threshold ≥0.5×10⁹/L sustained (§3.11). Do not use 9831 for NK-lineage LGL disease — indolent NK-LGLL has no dedicated code and 9948 is an aggressive-disease code (§5.3.3).

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Mature T-cell and NK cell leukemias
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ This entity is described almost exclusively in adults. Confirm independently in a paediatric patient and flag for senior pathology review before finalising.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Major criteria: >5×10⁹/L cells with a T-PLL phenotype, demonstrated T-cell clonality, and 14q32/Xq28 abnormality or TCL1/MTCP1 involvement — inv(14) or t(14;14) on karyotype/FISH (§3.11). Adult-only entity — retained per §7.5, do not remove.

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Mature T-cell and NK cell leukemias
morphology_entries.coding_note: CD3− CD16+ CD56+ with EBV positivity. Occurs in adolescents and young adults — genuinely relevant paediatrically. Registry policy: indolent NK-LGLL codes to 9948 unchanged with no indolent flag; survival analysis is done separately in biostatistics, not derived from the morphology code (§5.3.3). NK-LGLL diagnostic rule (Pastoret): ≥3 major criteria, or ≥2 major plus 2 minor. Two major criteria with no histological investigation is an explicitly unresolved grey zone — carry as a non-terminal state, do not force the call (§3.11). STAT3/STAT5B/CCL22/TET2 mutations are code-neutral.

Valid Ia4 terminal for a blood/marrow-presenting case with no further characterisation (Pathway §5.5.4). Dual-group by topography and confirmed as such by registry policy (§5.3.10) — see topography_routing_note. Prefer 9820 when the process is explicitly leukaemic; 9591 is for a non-Hodgkin lymphoma NOS abstracted at a Group I topography.
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: Dual-group by topography (Pathway §5.3.10). C42.0/C42.1/C42.3/C42.4 (blood/marrow/RES/haematopoietic system NOS) → Group I, Ia4. C42.2 (spleen) and every other site → Group II, IIb4 (Non-Hodgkin lymphomas, NOS).

morphology_entries.coding_note: Chain-termination root for the lymphoid fallback chains (Pathway §7.4) — nos_fallback_code is null by design. Reachable from a referral note alone. Also the mandated landing code for an unconfirmed mature T-cell leukaemia (never default to 9827 without confirmed HTLV-1 positivity, §6). Record why the case is NOS via workup_status.

Legacy FAB frame (≥80% erythroid, ≥30% proerythroblasts). ICD-O-3.2 code retained, but the blast denominator is now all nucleated marrow cells rather than non-erythroid cells, which retires the old erythroid/myeloid AEL split — 9840 no longer matches any current WHO definition (§2.2). Code conservatively to 9861 if uncertain.

Base AML code — MPO positive by the Bras rule (≥20% of blasts above the lymphocyte-derived threshold) or ≥2 of CD13/CD33/CD64/CD65/CD117 with B- and T-lineage criteria not met. Retained deliberately: WHO-HAEM5 eliminates 'AML, NOS' but ICC retains it and the registry code list requires it (§5.4). Landing code for the uncoded AML entities of §5.2 — NUP98-r, KAT6A::CREBBP, TP53-mutated AML — record the genotype in genotype_annotation. Also the resolution code for a myeloid sarcoma with concurrent marrow AML when the AML is unsubtyped (one case, coded as the AML — §4.7, §5.3.8).

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Acute myeloid leukemia with t(6;9)(p23;q34); DEK-NUP214
morphology_entries.coding_note: Karyotype plus FISH for t(6;9) DEK::NUP214.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ APL — haematological emergency. Document DIC screen and ATRA initiation. NPM1-mutated AML mimics APL (CD34−, HLA-DR−, MPO+, coagulopathy) but is CD4-positive with normal/low side scatter. Confirm PML::RARA before coding 9866.
morphology_entries.coding_note: HAEMATOLOGICAL EMERGENCY. Presumptive treatment (hypergranular promyelocytes/faggot cells plus coagulopathy → immediate ATRA) is a treatment rule, not a coding rule. For coding, confirm by FISH, RT-PCR/RQ-PCR/RT-QLAMP or anti-PML immunostaining; run RT-PCR in parallel where available (defines the PML::RARA isoform and enables MRD). Treat anti-PML IF as lower confidence unless the reader is experienced. Flow signature: HLA-DR−, CD34−, CD117 heterogeneous, MPO bright, CD15 dim/absent, CD13 heterogeneous, CD33 bright, high side scatter; microgranular variant (M3v) has lower SSC, frequent CD2/CD34 and high WBC but is still 9866. Mimic: an APL-like phenotype with CD4 positive, low/moderate SSC and high WBC — do not code 9866 until PML::RARA is molecularly excluded; if negative and NPM1-mutated, code 9877 (§3.6). PML::RARA isoform is code-neutral.
Use only if the report explicitly states the subtype (granulocytic plus monocytic differentiation). No dedicated corpus evidence — code conservatively to 9861 otherwise.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)(q21;q26.2) or t(13.3)(q21;q26.2); RPN1-EVI1
morphology_entries.coding_note: Karyotype plus FISH for inv(3)(q21q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2). Current nomenclature is GATA2::MECOM; the REDCap option string retains the older RPN1-EVI1 label and contains a transcription error in the translocation notation ('t(13.3)') — copied verbatim as required, flagged to the registry for correction.

Defined in classification anchors only, no dedicated corpus evidence. Use only if the report explicitly states acute basophilic leukaemia; otherwise 9861. Note that basophilic lineage is one of the five lineages that must be actively excluded before a positive AUL diagnosis (9801) — no basophilic marker is sourced in the evidence base (§4.1).

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Acute myeloid leukemia with abnormal marrow eosinophils
morphology_entries.coding_note: Karyotype plus FISH for inv(16)(p13.1q22) / t(16;16); CBFB::MYH11. The REDCap option string uses the descriptive morphological label ('with abnormal marrow eosinophils') rather than the genetic label — same code, copied verbatim as required.

Distinguished from acute undifferentiated leukaemia (9801/AUL) in the ALAL literature: 9872 still meets a myeloid lineage-defining criterion, AUL does not (§4.1). Requires a comprehensive panel to make the distinction safely.
FAB-descriptive terminal, no dedicated corpus evidence. Use only if the report explicitly states the subtype; otherwise 9861.
FAB-descriptive terminal, no dedicated corpus evidence. Use only if the report explicitly states the subtype; otherwise 9861.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ NPM1-mutated AML mimics APL (CD34−, HLA-DR−, MPO+, coagulopathy) but is CD4-positive with normal/low side scatter. Confirm PML::RARA is negative before coding 9877.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Added to the registry code set at ICD-O-3.2 (Pathway §5.7); previously and wrongly advised to 9861. Requires a documented NPM1 mutation. Principal APL mimic: shares CD33+/CD13+/cMPO+ with CD34−/HLA-DR− but is CD4-positive with low-to-moderate side scatter and high WBC, where APL has high SSC. Code 9877 only once PML::RARA is molecularly excluded (§3.6). Registry applies the ICC ≥10% blast floor (§5.4). NOTE: not present in the ICCC-2017 recode table (which predates ICD-O-3.2); Ib assignment follows Pathway §1. No REDCap dropdown option exists for this code — registry action required before this terminal can be selected in REDCap.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: AML with biallelic mutations of CEBPA
morphology_entries.coding_note: Added to the registry code set at ICD-O-3.2 (Pathway §5.7); previously and wrongly advised to 9861. Requires biallelic CEBPA mutation, or an in-frame bZIP mutation. One of the two blast-threshold exceptions: WHO-HAEM5 exempts both BCR::ABL1 and CEBPA from the blast requirement, ICC/ELN exempt only BCR::ABL1 from the ≥10% rule. The registry applies ICC thresholds (§5.4), so ≥10% blasts is required here. NOTE: not present in the ICCC-2017 recode table (which predates ICD-O-3.2); Ib assignment follows Pathway §1. No REDCap dropdown option exists for this code — registry action required before this terminal can be selected in REDCap.

Added to the registry code set at ICD-O-3.2 (Pathway §5.7); previously and wrongly advised to 9895. Requires a documented RUNX1 mutation. Boundary with 9895: RUNX1 is also a member of the nine-gene MDS-related set, so a case with a RUNX1 mutation and MDS-related cytogenetics or other MDS-related gene mutations may resolve to 9895 instead — record which rule was applied in classification_system. TP53-mutated (VAF ≥10%) takes precedence over both (§3.7). NOTE: not present in the ICCC-2017 recode table (which predates ICD-O-3.2); Ib assignment follows Pathway §1. No REDCap dropdown option exists for this code — registry action required before this terminal can be selected in REDCap.

Use only if the report explicitly states the subtype. Monocytic differentiation is established by ≥2 of non-specific esterase, CD11c, CD14, CD64, lysozyme (§2.3). No dedicated corpus evidence for the code itself — code conservatively to 9861 otherwise.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ ELN 2022 risk (favourable/intermediate/adverse) is prognostic only and never code-defining.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Requires MDS-related cytogenetics or a mutation in the nine-gene set (ASXL1, BCOR, EZH2, RUNX1, SF3B1, SRSF2, STAG2, U2AF1, ZRSR2), irrespective of prior MDS history (ELN 2022). TP53-mutated at VAF ≥10% takes precedence as a separate entity. WHO-HAEM5 treats AML-MR as a single entity; ICC splits it into TP53-mutated / MDS-related-gene / MDS-related-cytogenetic — record which was applied in classification_system (§3.7, §5.4). Exclusion rule: AML-MR-defining genetics or a complex karyotype exclude MPAL, so a biphenotypic immunophenotype with these genetics codes 9895, not 9805–9809 (§4.1).

Karyotype plus FISH for t(8;21)(q22;q22); RUNX1::RUNX1T1. Trap: aberrant CD19, PAX5 and cCD79a co-expression is common and is easily misread as B-lineage or MPAL. Aberrant B-marker expression in an MPO-strong blast population with t(8;21) is 9896 (§4.3).
KMT2A break-apart FISH. Myeloid lineage must be established first — a KMT2A rearrangement with B-lineage criteria is 9813, and with both B/T and myeloid criteria met is 9807 (§4.1).

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Transient abnormal myelopoiesis is **not** a malignancy. Confirm trisomy 21, GATA1s and age <3 months. If TAM criteria are met this case must reach a non-reportable terminal — never code 9898/3.
morphology_entries.coding_note: TRANSIENT ABNORMAL MYELOPOIESIS (TAM) — behaviour /1, the non-malignant member of the behaviour-overloaded 9898 pair. Criteria: age <3 months, confirmed trisomy 21, GATA1s mutation, spontaneous resolution. NON-REPORTABLE as a malignancy (§4.5, §4.9) — this entry exists so the behaviour code can be recorded, not so a malignant registration can be raised. Never code 9898/3 for a TAM case. Needs a watch flag with a re-entry path: 10–20% progress to true ML-DS, which is then coded 9898/3 at that later diagnosis. nos_fallback_code is deliberately null — a non-reportable terminal must never be wired to a malignant NOS fallback (§7.5). Distinguish from the third trisomy 21 entity, B-ALL in Down syndrome (9811 family, frequently CRLF2-rearranged). No REDCap dropdown option exists for the /1 behaviour — the single 9898 option string names the /3 entity only.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down Syndrome
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Down syndrome-associated — confirm trisomy 21 karyotype and GATA1s.
morphology_entries.coding_note: MYELOID LEUKAEMIA OF DOWN SYNDROME (ML-DS) — behaviour /3, the malignant member of the behaviour-overloaded 9898 pair. Criteria: age ≥3 months, confirmed trisomy 21, GATA1s mutation, blast criteria met (§3.8). Below 3 months with spontaneous resolution the case is TAM (9898/1) and is non-reportable. A TAM that later progresses re-enters here. Distinguish from the third trisomy 21 entity, B-ALL in Down syndrome (9811 family, frequently CRLF2-rearranged) — §4.5.

Flow pitfall: platelet adherence gives false-positive surface CD41/CD61 — wash adequately; intracellular CD61 is more specific. Landing code for the uncoded AMKL fusions of §5.2 — CBFA2T3::GLIS2 (cryptic on karyotype, needs RT-PCR/NGS; trisomy 3; 'RAM phenotype' = bright CD56, dim CD45/CD38, HLA-DR negative), NUP98-r AMKL and KMT2A-r AMKL — record the genotype in genotype_annotation. A normal karyotype must not close the CBFA2T3::GLIS2 branch (§4.4). t(1;22) upgrades to 9911.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Acute myeloid leukemia (megakaryoblastic) with t(1;22)(p13;q13); RBM15-MKL1
morphology_entries.coding_note: Karyotype plus FISH for t(1;22)(p13;q13). Current nomenclature is RBM15::MRTFA; the REDCap option string retains the older RBM15-MKL1 label — same code, copied verbatim as required (§3.8).

Added to the registry code set at ICD-O-3.2 (Pathway §5.7); previously and wrongly advised to 9861. Requires BCR::ABL1 plus AML criteria. Must be distinguished from CML in myeloid blast phase, which is 9875 — ask whether a preceding chronic phase is documented (§1, §3.9). BCR::ABL1 is the one abnormality for which both WHO-HAEM5 and ICC retain a blast-count requirement (§3.7, §5.4). NOTE: not present in the ICCC-2017 recode table (which predates ICD-O-3.2); Ib assignment follows Pathway §1. No REDCap dropdown option exists for this code — registry action required before this terminal can be selected in REDCap.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Prior cytotoxic therapy is a **qualifier** on the underlying neoplasm (ELN 2022), not a separate entity. Code the underlying subtype and set the qualifier rather than defaulting to 9920/9987.
morphology_entries.coding_note: CLOSED AS A TERMINAL (Pathway §4.8, §5.3.7). ELN 2022 holds that therapy-related myeloid neoplasm is no longer a disease entity — prior cytotoxic therapy is a QUALIFIER on the underlying diagnosis. Retained in the code set so historical records resolve, but no tree may land on it: terminal_reachable is false. Instead, code the underlying entity (for example, therapy-related AML with MDS-related cytogenetics resolves to 9895), capture prior_cytotoxic_therapy at document_inventory and set qualifiers: [therapy_related] on the output block. Build lint: prior_cytotoxic_therapy = yes together with a resolved code of 9920 or 9987 is a build error.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ 9930 resolves to Group I regardless of presenting site. Do not re-route an orbital, cutaneous or nodal myeloid sarcoma to Group II or IX.
morphology_entries.coding_note: The one Group I code that is not C42.x — coded to the involved site's topography (orbit, skin, lymph node, bone, testis, GI tract, peritoneum) via a site_resolution node (§4.7). primary_sites is deliberately left open. IHC markers are listed in order of frequency; about 30% are MPO-negative — the 'chloroma' green colour is MPO-driven but its absence does not exclude the diagnosis. Isolated myeloid sarcoma with a negative marrow is still 9930. Concurrent marrow AML is ONE case coded as the AML (SEER Rule M3, registry policy §5.3.8) — resolve to the specific AML subtype, or 9861 if unsubtyped, record the extramedullary site in topography and set myeloid_sarcoma_present. Misclassification risk: orbital or cutaneous myeloid sarcoma is easily mistaken for a Group II lymphoma or a Group IX soft-tissue sarcoma.
morphology_entries.topography_routing_note: **Always Group I (Ib), regardless of presenting site.** An orbital, cutaneous, nodal or other extramedullary myeloid sarcoma must **not** be re-routed to Group II or IX. Record the involved site in topography; it does not change the group. `primary_sites` is deliberately left open — 9930 is the one Group I code that is not C42.x.

morphology_entries.coding_note: Defined in classification anchors only, no dedicated corpus evidence. Requires a trephine (marrow fibrosis with panmyeloid proliferation). Use only if the report explicitly states it; otherwise 9861.

PLACEHOLDER ONLY — 'BCR::ABL1 pending'. Never a positive diagnosis (§3.9). Once BCR::ABL1 is confirmed positive the code is 9875 regardless of phase; if BCR::ABL1 is confirmed negative, reassess against atypical CML (9876) and the other MPN entities, not 9863. Record karyotype_result_status so a true NOS is distinguishable from an incomplete workup.

Karyotype t(9;22) plus RT-PCR, with FISH optional. BCR::ABL1 positive is 9875 REGARDLESS OF PHASE — phase is staging annotation, never a separate code (§3.9). Registry phase definition: WHO 2022 (chronic <20% blasts, blast phase ≥20%, no accelerated tier); record cml_phase for display only, never in resolution logic. Lymphoid blast crisis can masquerade as ALL: >5% morphologically apparent lymphoblasts with BCR::ABL1 and a documented preceding chronic phase is 9875, not 9812. Advanced phases can be present at diagnosis and must be distinguished from progression on TKI therapy. Transcript isoform (p190/p210) is code-neutral. There is no valid downgrade to a lesser CML code — the cytogenetics node's fallback is 9960 (§7.4).

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Atypical chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR/ABL negative
morphology_entries.coding_note: WBC ≥13×10⁹/L with immature granulocytes ≥10% of WBC, PB/BM blasts <20%, dysgranulopoiesis (hypo/hypersegmented neutrophils, abnormal chromatin clumping), eosinophils <10%, monocytes <10%, hypercellular marrow with granulocytic hyperplasia and dysplasia. Excludes BCR::ABL1 and the myeloid/lymphoid-neoplasm-with-eosinophilia kinase fusions. ICC additionally requires an MDS-qualifying cytopenia. SETBP1/ETNK1 are supportive, not required. Basophils <2% distinguishes it from CML but is not itself a formal criterion. WHO-HAEM5 renames this 'MDS/MPN with neutrophilia'; ICC keeps 'atypical CML' — naming only, same code (§3.9, §5.4).
Hb >16.5 g/dL (male) or >16.0 g/dL (female), or Hct >49% (male) or >48% (female), plus a JAK2 mutation. Vanishingly rare in children — confirm independently and flag for senior review.

Chain-termination root for the chronic myeloproliferative and eosinophilic fallback chains (Pathway §7.4) — nos_fallback_code is null by design. Also the mandated fallback for the CML cytogenetics node, which has no valid downgrade to a lesser CML code. Record why the case is NOS via workup_status and karyotype_result_status.
Trephine required: megakaryocyte atypia plus a graded reticulin stain, with a driver mutation (JAK2, CALR or MPL). Vanishingly rare in children — confirm independently and flag for senior review.
Platelets ≥450×10⁹/L with a JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation. Vanishingly rare in children — confirm independently and flag for senior review.

The gate is a DISJUNCTION and the registry adopts both routes (§3.9, §5.4). Route A (WHO-HAEM5, and ICC when CSF3R-negative): WBC ≥25×10⁹/L, molecular not required. Route B (ICC only): WBC ≥13×10⁹/L with an activating CSF3R mutation. Shared criteria for either route: segmented plus banded neutrophils ≥80% of WBC, precursors <10% of WBC, no significant dysgranulopoiesis, monocytes <10% of leukocytes, circulating blasts rare, hypercellular marrow with increased neutrophils showing normal maturation, and exclusion of BCR::ABL1-positive CML, PV, ET, PMF and myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and kinase fusions. ICC non-molecular alternative where CSF3R is unavailable: persistent neutrophilia ≥3 months plus splenomegaly plus documented exclusion of reactive causes. Phase is not a code: 10–19% blasts is accelerated phase, ≥20% is blast phase. Record classification_system.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Before any clonal eosinophilia code (9964–9968), document exclusion of parasitic infection and HIV. Unresolved secondary cause → do not code as a myeloid neoplasm. ⚠️ Cryptic deletion. Do not assign 9964 or exclude 9965 on a normal karyotype — FISH (CHIC2 deletion) or RT-PCR required.
morphology_entries.coding_note: STEP 1 IS A HARD GATE, not optional: exclude and document secondary causes first — parasitic (strongyloides, schistosoma, filariasis, hookworm, toxocara), HIV, drugs, allergy, autoimmune and solid-tumour-associated. In the UCI catchment hypereosinophilia is overwhelmingly parasitic or HIV-related; skipping step 1 is the largest single false-positive registration risk in Group I (§3.10). Only then test FIP1L1::PDGFRA (→ 9965), then karyotype for 5q31-33 PDGFRB (→ 9966) and 8p11-12 FGFR1 (→ 9967), then PCM1::JAK2 (→ 9968). 9964 is the terminal when clonality is demonstrated but no specific fusion is identified, and the provisional landing code for ETV6::ABL1 and FLT3-fusion cases, which have no dedicated ICD-O-3 code (§5.2) — record the fusion in genotype_annotation. No clonality demonstrated is idiopathic HES: NON-REPORTABLE, not 9964. Registry applies ICC criteria for CEL versus HES (§5.4).

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.coding_note: Persistent monocytosis, both absolute (≥0.5×10⁹/L) AND relative (≥10% of WBC), with blasts <20%. CMML-1 is PB <5% / BM <10% blasts; CMML-2 is 5–19% / 10–19%. Two-tier supporting-criteria rule: monocytosis ≥1×10⁹/L requires ≥1 supporting criterion; monocytosis 0.5–<1×10⁹/L requires BOTH (dysplasia ≥10% in ≥1 lineage; clonal cytogenetic or molecular evidence). Exclude reactive monocytosis, especially at the ≥1×10⁹/L level (TB and other infection are common in the UCI catchment). CMUS/CCMUS — persistent monocytosis ≥10% and ≥0.5×10⁹/L with the criteria not met — is NOT malignant, has no code and must not be reported (§3.10, §4.9). WHO-HAEM5 and ICC have converged on the monocyte threshold, so no arbitration applies.

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Germline PTPN11 without a somatic secondary lesion is Noonan-spectrum myeloproliferation, not JMML. Confirm a somatic RAS-pathway lesion before coding 9946.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Category I (clinical/haematological, all four assessed, last two MANDATORY): PB monocytes ≥1×10⁹/L (absent in about 7%); splenomegaly (absent in about 3%); blasts <20% in PB and BM (mandatory); absence of BCR::ABL1 (mandatory). Category II (genetic, ≥1 required, present in >95% of true JMML): somatic PTPN11, KRAS, NRAS or RRAS; germline NF1 with LOH, or clinical NF1 (≥6 café-au-lait macules >5 mm); germline CBL with LOH. Supporting: HbF elevated for age, circulating myeloid precursors, monosomy 7. AGE IS NOT DIAGNOSTIC — prognostic only. Noonan-spectrum myeloproliferative disease (germline PTPN11/KRAS/NRAS/RIT1 with NO somatic secondary mutation, normal karyotype, self-limiting) is a distinct non-reportable entity — do not auto-code 9946. ICC's RAS-negative 'JMML-like neoplasm' category is NOT adopted; those cases code to 9975 on their own merits (§3.4, §5.3.2). DNA-methylation subgroups (LM/IM/HM) are prognostic and code-neutral. Spontaneous regression (about 15%) does not retract the diagnosis — code at diagnosis on the evidence then available (§5.3.9). Also exclude malaria/HIV hypersplenism, which confounds the splenomegaly and monocyte criteria (§4.9).

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.coding_note: MDS/MPN overlap not meeting the criteria for CMML, atypical CML, JMML or MDS/MPN-RS-T. Also the landing code for RAS-pathway-negative JMML-like mimics, including ALK, ROS1, FIP1L1::RARA and CCDC88C::FLT3 fusions — ICC's 'JMML-like neoplasm' category is not adopted, and these cases are coded 9975 on their own merits, not 9946 (§3.4, §5.2, §5.3.2). Record the fusion in genotype_annotation. Chain-termination root for the MDS/MPN fallback chain (Pathway §7.4) — nos_fallback_code is null by design. Note the REDCap option string ends with a full stop; it is reproduced verbatim.

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Before coding paediatric MDS, document germline predisposition testing (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ETV6, ANKRD26) and IBMFS exclusion (chromosome breakage, telomere length). These do not change the code but must be recorded.
morphology_entries.coding_note: FAB-era term, retained as a live code. Also the ICD-O-3.2 replacement for the retired 9991 (refractory neutropenia) and 9992 (refractory thrombocytopenia) — §5.7. Not a paediatric entity in practice: the working paediatric MDS code set is 9985 (RCC / low blast), 9983 (excess blasts) and 9989 (NOS). SEER over-counting rule: within the MDS family code only the first subtype diagnosed; do not re-abstract a later, more specific MDS subtype (§3.5).

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ This entity is described almost exclusively in adults. Confirm independently in a paediatric patient and flag for senior pathology review before finalising. ⚠️ Before coding paediatric MDS, document germline predisposition testing (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ETV6, ANKRD26) and IBMFS exclusion (chromosome breakage, telomere length). These do not change the code but must be recorded.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Ring sideroblasts (iron stain on the marrow aspirate) with an SF3B1 mutation. Note the REDCap option string reads 'Refractory anemia with sideroblasts' whereas Pathway §1 names the entity 'Refractory anemia with ring sideroblasts' — the REDCap string is reproduced verbatim as required. Under 1% of paediatric MDS; adult-only in practice — retained per §7.5, do not remove. SEER over-counting rule applies (§3.5).

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Before coding paediatric MDS, document germline predisposition testing (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ETV6, ANKRD26) and IBMFS exclusion (chromosome breakage, telomere length). These do not change the code but must be recorded.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Paediatric MDS with excess blasts: BM blasts 5–19%, PB blasts 2–19% — the paediatric band, which the registry applies because ICC explicitly excludes patients under 18 years from the 'MDS/AML' 10–19% category (§2.2, §5.4). Part of the working paediatric MDS code set with 9985 and 9989. Mandatory pre-conditions before any sporadic paediatric MDS code: germline predisposition screen (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ANKRD26, ETV6), IBMFS exclusion (chromosome breakage/G2 arrest for Fanconi, telomere length for dyskeratosis congenita, consider Shwachman-Diamond), and — Uganda addition — exclusion of nutritional (B12/folate/iron) and HIV-related cytopenia first (§3.5). SEER over-counting rule applies.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Refractory anemia with excess blasts in transformation
morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.coding_note: OBSOLETE — abolished in 2001. WHO 2001 lowered the AML blast threshold from 30% to 20%, absorbing the whole RAEB-T band; the code has had no live entity behind it since (Pathway §5.3.6). Retained only so pre-2001 archival records and aliases resolve; must never be selected as a live terminal and must never be the nos_fallback_code of another entry. A current case in the old RAEB-T blast band is an AML — code the AML entity.

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Before coding paediatric MDS, document germline predisposition testing (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ETV6, ANKRD26) and IBMFS exclusion (chromosome breakage, telomere length). These do not change the code but must be recorded.
morphology_entries.coding_note: THE PAEDIATRIC RCC CODE — the commonest MDS of childhood (about 50%). SEER lists 'Refractory cytopenia of childhood (RCC)' and 'Childhood MDS with low blasts (cMDS-LB)' as explicit alternate names for 9985/3; the current WHO-5 label is 'MDS with low blasts, NOS'. This is a code-currency fact, not a registry decision, and requires no sign-off (§3.5, §5.3.1). Criteria (ICC): persistent age-adjusted cytopenia; dysplasia in ≥2 lineages or ≥10% in one; blasts PB <2% and BM <5%; no prior cytotoxic therapy; no fibrosis. About 80% have a hypocellular marrow with patchy erythroid islands; monosomy 7 in about 20%. CD61 or CD41 IHC ON THE TREPHINE IS MANDATORY — it identifies micromegakaryocytes, the feature that separates RCC from severe aplastic anaemia, the key differential and a non-reportable terminal. Mandatory pre-conditions as for 9983 (germline screen, IBMFS exclusion, nutritional and HIV exclusion) — germline findings are recorded as a modifier and do not change the code. SEER over-counting rule applies.

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ This entity is described almost exclusively in adults. Confirm independently in a paediatric patient and flag for senior pathology review before finalising. ⚠️ Before coding paediatric MDS, document germline predisposition testing (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ETV6, ANKRD26) and IBMFS exclusion (chromosome breakage, telomere length). These do not change the code but must be recorded.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Isolated del(5q) on karyotype or FISH. Rare in children; adult-only in practice — retained per §7.5, do not remove. SEER over-counting rule applies (§3.5).

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Prior cytotoxic therapy is a **qualifier** on the underlying neoplasm (ELN 2022), not a separate entity. Code the underlying subtype and set the qualifier rather than defaulting to 9920/9987.
morphology_entries.coding_note: CLOSED AS A TERMINAL (Pathway §4.8, §5.3.7) — same handling as 9920. Prior cytotoxic therapy is a QUALIFIER on the underlying diagnosis (ELN 2022), not a separate entity. Retained in the code set so historical records resolve, but no tree may land on it: terminal_reachable is false. Code the underlying MDS subtype, capture prior_cytotoxic_therapy at document_inventory and set qualifiers: [therapy_related] on the output block. Build lint: prior_cytotoxic_therapy = yes together with a resolved code of 9920 or 9987 is a build error.

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Before coding paediatric MDS, document germline predisposition testing (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ETV6, ANKRD26) and IBMFS exclusion (chromosome breakage, telomere length). These do not change the code but must be recorded.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Chain-termination root for the MDS fallback chain (Pathway §7.4) — nos_fallback_code is null by design. Use when dysplasia is documented but the subtype is not stated. Part of the working paediatric MDS code set with 9985 and 9983. Record why the case is NOS via workup_status. SEER over-counting rule: code only the first MDS subtype diagnosed; do not re-abstract a later, more specific subtype (§3.5).

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.coding_note: RETIRED at ICD-O-3.2 — replaced by 9980/3 (Pathway §5.7). Retained so aliases and pre-2021 archival records resolve; must never be selected as a live terminal and must never be the nos_fallback_code of another entry. Previously counted within the SEER MDS over-counting family (§3.5).

morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.coding_note: RETIRED at ICD-O-3.2 — replaced by 9980/3 (Pathway §5.7). Retained so aliases and pre-2021 archival records resolve; must never be selected as a live terminal and must never be the nos_fallback_code of another entry. Previously counted within the SEER MDS over-counting family (§3.5).

morphology_entries.morphology_name: MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia
morphology_entries.iccc3_subgroup_name: Myelodysplastic syndrome and other myeloproliferative diseases
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ This entity is described almost exclusively in adults. Confirm independently in a paediatric patient and flag for senior pathology review before finalising. ⚠️ Before coding paediatric MDS, document germline predisposition testing (GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ETV6, ANKRD26) and IBMFS exclusion (chromosome breakage, telomere length). These do not change the code but must be recorded.
morphology_entries.coding_note: Added to the registry code set at ICD-O-3.2 (Pathway §5.7); not addressed by the previous 76-code list. Ring sideroblasts plus multilineage dysplasia, with or without an SF3B1 mutation. Adult-predominant — keep the age-implausibility warning; rare in children. Distinguish from 9982 (ring sideroblasts, single lineage). SEER over-counting rule applies (§3.5). NOTE: not present in the ICCC-2017 recode table (which predates ICD-O-3.2); Id assignment follows Pathway §1. No REDCap dropdown option exists for this code — registry action required before this terminal can be selected in REDCap.

Root chain-termination code for the whole group (Pathway §7.4) — nos_fallback_code is null by design. Stage 2A clinical-alias terminal for a referral note that says only 'leukaemia' with no lineage and no acuity. LOW confidence by definition. Record why via workup_status (pending / not done / unavailable / declined); 'cytogenetics unavailable at UCI' is a legitimate, permanent terminal state (§2.5). Upgrade to 9801, 9820 or 9860 as soon as acuity or lineage is documented.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ MPAL requires MPO positivity (≥20% of blasts above lymphocyte threshold) on the **same** blast population as the lymphoid markers. AML-MR genetics or a complex karyotype exclude MPAL → code 9895.
morphology_entries.coding_note: THREE SITUATIONS ON ONE CODE, disambiguated by workup_status plus alal_subtype (§4.1). (1) AUL — a POSITIVE diagnosis of exclusion: comprehensive panel, no lineage-defining marker (MPO, CD3, and the B-lineage set) and no more than ONE lineage-associated marker for ANY single lineage; workup_status complete, alal_subtype aul. (2) ALAL-NOS — ≥2 markers of one lineage but no lineage-defining marker; workup_status complete, alal_subtype alal_nos. 9805 is wrong for ALAL-NOS by definition (9805 is MPAL-NOS, which ALAL-NOS explicitly does not meet). (3) NOS sense — lineage not established because the panel was incomplete, unavailable, not done or declined; alal_subtype null; do not report as AUL. The workup_status values pending / not done / unavailable / declined must be reachable only by the third row. Panel adequacy is the second gate: five lineages must be actively excluded — megakaryocytic (CD41/CD61 negative), erythrocytic (glycophorin A negative), NK (CD56 negative) as hard gates; plasmacytoid dendritic (CD123/HLA-DR/CD11c negative) as a SOFT warning only, since CD123 alone does not settle it and CD303/BDCA-2, TCL1 and TCF4 are better but unsourced; and basophilic, for which no marker is sourced. Cases assignable to another genetically or clinically defined category (AML-MR, AML with a defining genetic abnormality, therapy-related AML, CML blast crisis, myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with a kinase fusion) are NOT AUL — code that entity. Check for BCL11B rearrangement/activation before coding 9801. 'Acute leukemia, NOS' is ICD-O-3.2's own preferred term; the AUL preferred term is a WHO 2008 change already inside ICD-O-3 before 3.2 (§5.7).

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ MPAL requires MPO positivity (≥20% of blasts above lymphocyte threshold) on the **same** blast population as the lymphoid markers. AML-MR genetics or a complex karyotype exclude MPAL → code 9895.
morphology_entries.coding_note: MPAL-NOS — MPAL criteria met but the combination is neither B/myeloid nor T/myeloid, or the combination is unspecified. Requires total blasts ≥20%. NOT AUL: acute undifferentiated leukaemia is 9801 with alal_subtype aul (§4.1). Lineage criteria per §2.3 (WHO-HAEM5), applied GENETICS-FIRST — evaluate BCR::ABL1 and KMT2A before falling through to the unconditioned rules. Two exclusion rules WHO 2016 lacked: AML-MR-defining genetics or a complex karyotype code 9895, not MPAL; a divergent-lineage clone in <5% of cells codes the dominant leukaemia with a descriptive modifier, not MPAL. Do not use the AIEOP-BFM 'dominant lineage' treatment-track label as the diagnosis.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia with t(9;22)(q34;q11.2); BCR-ABL1
morphology_entries.nos_fallback_name: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid, NOS
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ MPAL requires MPO positivity (≥20% of blasts above lymphocyte threshold) on the **same** blast population as the lymphoid markers. AML-MR genetics or a complex karyotype exclude MPAL → code 9895.
morphology_entries.coding_note: B plus myeloid lineage criteria met with BCR::ABL1 positive. Not evidenced as a named subtype in the corpus — resolve it from the lineage criteria (§2.3) plus the genetic result, not from a report label. Molecular 'when' conditions must precede unconditioned rules in the resolution logic (§7.3 #3, §7.5 ordering lint).

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia with t(v;11q23); MLL rearranged
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ MPAL requires MPO positivity (≥20% of blasts above lymphocyte threshold) on the **same** blast population as the lymphoid markers. AML-MR genetics or a complex karyotype exclude MPAL → code 9895.
morphology_entries.coding_note: B or T plus myeloid lineage criteria met with a KMT2A rearrangement. Fallback is 9805 rather than 9808/9809 because this code does not itself fix the lymphoid lineage. Not evidenced as a named subtype in the corpus — resolve it from the lineage criteria plus KMT2A break-apart FISH, not from a report label. Molecular 'when' conditions must precede unconditioned rules in the resolution logic (§7.3 #3, §7.5 ordering lint).

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid, NOS
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ MPAL requires MPO positivity (≥20% of blasts above lymphocyte threshold) on the **same** blast population as the lymphoid markers. AML-MR genetics or a complex karyotype exclude MPAL → code 9895.
morphology_entries.coding_note: B AND myeloid criteria both met with no defining genetics (§4.1). B criterion: CD19 strong plus ≥1 strongly expressed of CD10/CD22/CD79a, or CD19 weak plus ≥2 of the same; CD79a is only valid if T lineage is not under consideration. Myeloid criterion: MPO above the Bras threshold on the SAME blast population, or monocytic differentiation by ≥2 of non-specific esterase, CD11c, CD14, CD64, lysozyme. Landing code for MPAL-ZNF384-r (about 50% of paediatric B/myeloid MPAL), which has no ICD-O-3 code — record the genotype in genotype_annotation (§5.2).

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia, T/myeloid, NOS
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ MPAL requires MPO positivity (≥20% of blasts above lymphocyte threshold) on the **same** blast population as the lymphoid markers. AML-MR genetics or a complex karyotype exclude MPAL → code 9895.
morphology_entries.coding_note: T AND myeloid criteria both met with no defining genetics (§4.1). T criterion: cytoplasmic or surface CD3 with intensity in part exceeding 50% of the mature T-cell level (anti-CD3 epsilon-chain antibody), or immunocytochemistry positive with a non-zeta-chain reagent. Boundary with ETP-ALL (9837) is MPO: MPO-positive by the Bras rule is 9809, MPO-negative is 9837 — getting this wrong moves the case between the two codes (§4.2). Landing code for ALAL-BCL11B-r (about 20–30% of T/myeloid MPAL and of ETP-ALL), which has no ICD-O-3 code — record the genotype in genotype_annotation (§5.2).

Chain-termination root for the myeloid fallback chain (Pathway §7.4) — nos_fallback_code is null by design. Reachable from a referral note that establishes myeloid lineage but neither acuity nor subtype. Record why via workup_status.

morphology_entries.morphology_name: Myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with PDGFRA rearrangement
morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Before any clonal eosinophilia code (9964–9968), document exclusion of parasitic infection and HIV. Unresolved secondary cause → do not code as a myeloid neoplasm. ⚠️ Cryptic deletion. Do not assign 9964 or exclude 9965 on a normal karyotype — FISH (CHIC2 deletion) or RT-PCR required.
morphology_entries.coding_note: CRYPTIC — FIP1L1::PDGFRA is invisible on karyotype; requires FISH for the CHIC2 deletion or RT-PCR. A normal karyotype must never close this branch or resolve to 9964 (§4.4, §7.5). The secondary-eosinophilia exclusion cascade (parasitic, HIV, drugs, allergy, autoimmune, solid-tumour-associated) is a hard gate that must be documented BEFORE this code is reachable (§3.10). Clinically important because these cases are imatinib-responsive.

morphology_entries.clinical_alert: ⚠️ Before any clonal eosinophilia code (9964–9968), document exclusion of parasitic infection and HIV. Unresolved secondary cause → do not code as a myeloid neoplasm.

morphology_entries.coding_note: Added to the registry code set at ICD-O-3.2 (Pathway §5.7); previously and wrongly advised to 9964. Requires t(8;9)(p22;p24) on karyotype, or FISH, or RT-PCR for PCM1::JAK2. The secondary-eosinophilia exclusion cascade is a hard gate that must be documented before this code is reachable (§3.10). NOTE: not present in the ICCC-2017 recode table (which predates ICD-O-3.2); Ie assignment follows Pathway §1. No REDCap dropdown option exists for this code — registry action required before this terminal can be selected in REDCap.
